title: New shell
brief: Hyprland + Quickshell desktop redesign: top bar with an extensible center pill, bottom dock whose launcher rises from it, desktop widgets, colors generated from the wallpaper by matugen with a sky-blue bias

artboards.title: Fused frame
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the reference and very cohesive; the solid frame costs screen space and blocks the wallpaper edges

artboards.title: Floating islands
artboards.tradeoff: Light and modern with full wallpaper; blur costs GPU and contrast depends on the wallpaper

artboards.title: Edge minimal
artboards.tradeoff: Maximum wallpaper and focus; hidden dock is slower to reach and text widgets can lose legibility

artboards.title: Continuous frame
artboards.tradeoff: Everything is one shape attached to the monitor edge (thin top bar through the notch, dock carved into the bottom with flared curves); matches the reference best, costs a thin border on every edge
